metadata.title: PQ-Attest P7 Grounded RTL Mutant Proposals and Triage
metadata.author: PQ-Attest Engineer 4
metadata.disclaimer: These RTL proposals are candidate faults grounded in actual RTL source files and Lane 1 registered evidence. They are distinguished from Python behavioral reference model mutants.

proposals.intended_defect: Route Y-dimension before X-dimension on mesh hops.
proposals.verdict_detail: Real gap identified by E4: survived every existing bench (hop-probes passed 414/414) because YX preserves hop count.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: Killed by 12 x SPEC_XY_* in tb_i11_noc_spec (every diagonal route fails literal spec assertion).
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Oracle-independence fix: tb_i11_noc_spec checks literal M-F1 coordinate expectations, not derived hop counts.

proposals.intended_defect: Suppress credit return pulse when VC FIFO flit is popped.
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by Lane 1 credit loss mutant control.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED: Credit underflow / permanent stall detected by credit counter assertion.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Existing credit benches assert return balance independently.

proposals.intended_defect: Remap ATTESTATION message to VC 0 instead of VC 2 in message_to_vc().
proposals.verdict_detail: Real gap identified by E4: survived because existing benches derived expected VC using the same package function under test.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: Killed by 4 x SPEC_VC_ATTEST_4..7 in tb_i11_noc_spec (literal M-F1 VC table comparison).
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Oracle-independence fix: tb_i11_noc_spec uses literal M-F1 table constants rather than calling message_to_vc().

proposals.intended_defect: Remove FIFO full check on push.
proposals.verdict_detail: Not a killable control: credit flow control never writes a full FIFO.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: N/A (credit flow control never writes a full FIFO).
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Credit flow control ensures FIFO full condition is unreachable in normal operation.

proposals.intended_defect: NI slot timeout counter comparison disabled (never expires).
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-9 negative control.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED by tb_i9_integ: SLOT_RECOVER fails when slot is not autonomously freed after T_SLOT cycles.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Checks autonomous slot deallocation independently of response arrival.

proposals.intended_defect: Deliver late/stale response arriving after slot timeout.
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-9 negative control.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED by tb_i9_integ: I9_STALE_DROPPED fails if app_rx_head_valid pulses for expired tag.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Monitors app_rx interface for unauthorized pulses following slot retirement.

proposals.intended_defect: L2 KMAC authentication tag comparison forced valid.
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by S2 and I-7 negative controls.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED by s2_attacks and i7_mut_tag_off: corrupt tag accepted into secured core.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Exhaustive negative vector testbench injects invalid KMAC digests.

proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-7 and S-2 controls. Verifier has no separate epoch compare; epoch is cryptographically bound into the expected tag.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED: SEC_STALE_EPOCH triggered by mismatch in reconstructed KMAC verification digest.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Epoch freshness is cryptographically embedded into message digest, not tested by an arithmetic comparator.

proposals.intended_defect: Attestation gate allows data packets while in reset or unauthorized state.
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-6 and P-7 gate controls.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED: Gate violation flag raised on unauthorised flit egress.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Gate monitors data transit independently of control state.

proposals.intended_defect: Allow Tile-2 BRAM accesses outside the 16KB window (OFF >= 0x4000).
proposals.verdict_detail: Real gap identified by E4: previously only the window shrink direction was controlled. Implemented as new control in I-11.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED by I9_WINDOW_OUT_ERR (out-of-window access correctly caught before reaching BRAM macro).
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Front-end decodes address bits [31:14] and generates error response without forwarding to BRAM.

proposals.intended_defect: Commit memory write when wstrb is all-zero (wstrb = 4'b0000).
proposals.verdict_detail: Not a killable control: all-zero wstrb is a specification question, not an established defect.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: N/A (all-zero wstrb is a specification question, not an established defect; byte-lane mapping is separately killed by i9_mut_bram_lanes).
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Byte lane mapping is tested by reading back partial-word stores.

proposals.intended_defect: Accept attestation measurement message with length > 135 bytes.
proposals.verdict_detail: Not a killable control: length greater than 135 bytes is unreachable past K-3.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: N/A (length greater than 135 bytes is unreachable past K-3).
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Unit invalid-length vectors tested in standalone s8_golden bench.

proposals.intended_defect: Endpoint controller truncates IMEM measurement read length to 16 bytes instead of 64 bytes.
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-10 D2 negative control.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED by tb_i10_d2: digest mismatch when bytes 16..63 are excluded from Keccak sponge absorb.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: D2 test vectors require exact 87-byte measurement message hash.

proposals.intended_defect: Truncate or ignore tile ID comparison during attestation verification.
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-7 and S-2 controls. Verifier has no separate tile ID compare: tile ID is bound directly into KDF personalization string and KMAC tag.
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED: SEC_WRONG_IDENTITY asserted on tile ID alteration.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Cryptographic identity binding prevents identity substitution without valid key and digest.

proposals.intended_defect: Verifier accepts repeated nonce from previous challenge (nonce reuse).
proposals.verdict_detail: Already covered by I-7 control. Nonce issuer is deterministic demo logic (no TRNG claim).
proposals.oracle_kill_signature: KILLED: Stale nonce error asserted when previously presented nonce is reused.
proposals.oracle_independence_notes: Verifier tracks issued challenge nonces and rejects duplicates.
